title: Sahitya - Dutiman Alochana (সাহিত্য - দুটিমান আলোচনা)
author: Dr. Lila Gogoi (ড° লীলা গগৈ)
description: Scholarly critical essays on the confluence of Tai culture and Assamese literature by renowned folklorist and historian Dr. Lila Gogoi. The volume examines Buranji prose structures, Tai-Ahom manuscript illumination, and the linguistic heritage preserved by the Tai-Khamyang community along the Burhi Dihing.
source: Dibrugarh: Banalata Prakashan, Archive ID: in.ernet.dli.2015.451708
